quote: Because the Servo library takes over Timer1.
fix: The Servo library takes over Timer1.
note: Sentence fragment starting with subordinating conjunction Because.

quote: With 4x decoding, how many counts per revolution does the code see?
fix: With X4 decoding, how many counts per revolution does the code see?
note: Inconsistent term: 'X4 decoding' is used earlier in this lesson.

quote: motor shaft carries a 500 PPR encoder read with 4x decoding. The resulting rate
fix: motor shaft carries a 500 PPR encoder read with X4 decoding. The resulting rate
note: Inconsistent term: 'X4 decoding' is used earlier in this lesson.

quote: equipped with 360 PPR encoders running 4x decoding, if the microcontroller registers
fix: equipped with 360 PPR encoders running X4 decoding, if the microcontroller registers

quote: Robot arm controllers can also add model-based feed-forward computed from the rigid-body equations
fix: Robot arm controllers can also add model-based feedforward computed from the rigid-body equations
note: Inconsistent spelling: 'feedforward' is spelled without a hyphen earlier in this lesson.

quote: blinds the robot to sensory events and user e-stops, because nothing else in the program
fix: blinds the robot to sensory events and user emergency stops, because nothing else in the program
note: Inconsistent term: 'emergency stop' is used throughout the rest of this lesson.

quote: must transition to STOP upon an e-stop event or safety timeout.
fix: must transition to STOP upon an emergency stop event or safety timeout.

quote: makes the estimation uncertainty \(\mathbf{P}_k^-\) to grow during prediction.
